sources.entry: Soundful - AI-driven sound and music generation.

summary.name: Soundful
summary.one_liner: Soundful is an AI music generation platform that creates royalty-free, producer-assisted tracks for brands, agencies and creators.
use_cases: create royalty-free background music for videos
generate commercial music for brand campaigns
build a consistent sonic brand identity
make tracks for social media content
produce music for agency client campaigns
summary.what_it_does: Soundful generates original music by letting users choose a genre and template, producing a studio-quality track in seconds. The page says its tracks are created by producers assisted by AI and use sounds it sources itself rather than scraped material. Users can download tracks royalty-free based on their subscription tier, with licenses described as suitable for professional and commercial use. Licensing is split between non-exclusive tracks (Standard and Content Creator plans) and exclusive licenses (Music Creator Plus users or purchased copyrights). The page also offers enterprise services such as end-to-end sonic branding and partner programs for agencies.
notable: Producer-assisted AI music with sounds it states it sources itself, positioned as free from copyright risk
Every generated track is unique; the same track is never created twice, so tracks must be saved to be retrieved
Non-exclusive licenses on Standard and Content Creator plans; exclusive licenses via Music Creator Plus or copyright purchase
Offers enterprise sonic branding and agency partnership programs
caveats: Tracks under Standard and Content Creator plans are non-exclusive, so other users can use the same sounds
Tracks not saved after generation cannot be recreated
Downloads depend on subscription tier; the page does not list specific prices
